unit_attributes.statement: An employer must permit an employee of a public agency (which is a State, political subdivision of a State, or an interstate governmental agency) who has accrued compensatory time off authorized under paragraph (1) and who has requested the use of such compensatory time to use such time within a reasonable period after making the request, if the use of the compensatory time does not unduly disrupt the operations of the public agency.
